title: Developing an AI-assisted MMA career simulator — balancing realism and gameplay
author: Final_Salamander_796
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/2xaqkoxtuswh1.png

Hi everyone!

I'm an independent game creator from South Africa, currently developing and improving Mobile MMA SIM, an MMA career simulation available on Android.

I've used AI-assisted tools during development, alongside my own planning, design decisions, testing, and iterative improvements.

The game focuses on fighter progression, contracts, rankings, training, and tactical combat.

One of the more difficult parts has been balancing striking and grappling while keeping fight outcomes varied and career progression realistic.

I've also been working on regression testing and fixing issues discovered through player feedback.

I'm interested in hearing how other AI-assisted developers approach testing and balancing simulation-heavy games.

Google Play:
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobilemmasim.myapp](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobilemmasim.myapp)
